summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of BridgeBot visual update: new interlinking stroked-bubble BridgeBotLogo (viewBox 0 0 100 90) and neon blue/cyan glow effects. All 14 features verified successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual update fully tested. New BridgeBotLogo SVG (viewBox='0 0 100 90') uses clipPath-based weave effect: blue bubble (left) goes OVER cyan at top, cyan bubble (right) goes OVER blue at bottom. Subtle white oval eyes in center. Neon glow effects verified on: primary buttons (box-shadow: rgba(59,130,246,0.45) 0px 0px 20px), channel card hovers, FAQ open state (box-shadow + border-color change), hero background radial gradients, CTA section. Logo verified on: Landing page navbar, Login page (links to /), Admin dashboard sidebar (2 instances), Docs page header (links to /), Chat page (header + empty state). All navigation routes working. Homepage sections fade in on scroll via IntersectionObserver.

logo_verification.design: Two thick-stroked OUTLINED speech bubbles that INTERLINK/WEAVE through each other. Blue bubble (left, tail bottom-left) goes OVER cyan at top; cyan bubble (right, tail bottom-right) goes OVER blue at bottom. Subtle white oval eyes in center.
